cc:Work.dc:description: Three descending tiers list free cleanup and no-grad checks; smaller batches, accumulation, mixed precision and sequence length; then activation checkpointing, freezing and quantisation. Model size and hardware come last.

path.style: fill: none; stroke: #234c3c; stroke-width: 3; stroke-linecap: round

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52645a
font-weight: 700; font-size: 24px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #234c3c
font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52645a

g.text: Start with retained state and evaluation habits; change capacity after cheaper fixes.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 19px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #234c3c
font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #202d28

g.text: Restart; release retained graphs; use no_grad; delete unused tensors.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 19px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #234c3c
font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #202d28

g.text: Smaller batches + accumulation; mixed precision; shorter sequences.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 19px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #234c3c
font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #202d28

g.text: Checkpoint activations; freeze parameters; quantise frozen weights.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #234c3c

g.text: Then consider a smaller model or more hardware.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52645a

g.text: Savings depend on the cause. The order expresses troubleshooting cost, not guaranteed memory savings.
